_doc: VALUE-FREE + PROSE-FREE analytic brain. Defines WHAT to compute and HOW to render. Contains NO numbers, NO sentences, NO dataset. Pairs 1:1 with template.ast.json by shared IDs.

topics.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Annual Report, 2025 [January, 2025 – December, 2025]

questions.intent: What was the Unemployment Rate (UR) in usual status (ps+ss) among educated persons (secondary and above) by gender in the age group 15 years and above in 2025?
How did the Unemployment Rate (UR) in usual status (ps+ss) among urban female (age 15+) change from 2024 to 2025?
Was there a difference in the Unemployment Rate (UR) in usual status (ps+ss) between rural and urban sectors for persons aged 15 years and above in 2025?

topics.title: 1 Stable Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for persons of age 15 years and above

questions.intent: What was the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for rural male and female persons of age 15 years and above in 2025, and how did it compare between the two genders?
How did the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for persons of age 15 years and above in rural areas compare to that in urban areas in 2025?
What was the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for persons of age 15 years and above in 2025, and how did it change from the previous year?

topics.title: 2 Worker Population Ratio (WPR) for persons of age 15 years and above remains sustained

questions.intent: What is the Worker Population Ratio (WPR) for rural male and female persons of age 15 years and above in 2025, and how do they compare?
What is the trend in Worker Population Ratio (WPR) for urban persons of age 15 years and above from 2022 to 2025?
How does the Worker Population Ratio (WPR) for rural persons of age 15 years and above compare to that of urban persons in 2025?

topics.title: 3 Unemployment Rates (UR) reflect stability and improvement for persons of age 15 years and

questions.intent: What was the difference in unemployment rates between males and females in rural areas in 2025?
How did the unemployment rate in urban areas change from 2022 to 2025?
What was the difference in unemployment rates between rural and urban areas in 2025?

topics.title: 4 Increase in proportion of workers with regular wage/ salary employment

questions.intent: What is the percentage point increase in the share of regular wage/salaried employment for male workers from 2022 to 2025?
How does the share of self-employment in 2024 compare to 2025 for both male and female workers?
What is the percentage distribution of female workers engaged in casual labor in 2024 versus 2025?

topics.title: 5 Manufacturing and service sectors witnessed enhanced worker participation

questions.intent: What is the change in the share of employment in construction from 2024 to 2025?
What is the change in the percentage of workers in manufacturing from 2024 to 2025?
What is the change in the share of employment in other services from 2024 to 2025?
What is the difference in average earnings growth between male and female workers in regular wage/salaried employment from 2024 to 2025?
What is the ratio of average earnings of female workers to male workers in regular wage/salaried employment in 2025?
How does the percentage growth in earnings of female workers compare to that of male workers in regular wage/salaried employment from 2024 to 2025?

topics.title: 7 Average number of years in formal education

questions.intent: What is the difference in average number of years in formal education between males and females aged 15 years and above at the all-India level in 2025?
What is the difference in average number of years in formal education between urban and rural areas for males aged 15 years and above in 2025?
What is the average number of years in formal education for persons aged 25 years and above, and how does it compare to those aged 15 years and above in 2025?
